tools.name: nylas_list_grants
tools.description: List the connected accounts (grants) on this Nylas application, each with a grant_id used to scope other tools. Not grant-scoped. Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants.

tools.name: nylas_get_grant
tools.description: Get details for a single connected account (grant). Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}.

tools.name: nylas_list_messages
tools.description: List email messages for the connected account, with optional filters. Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/messages.

tools.name: nylas_get_message
tools.description: Get a single email message by id. Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/messages/{message_id}.

tools.name: nylas_list_folders
tools.description: List mail folders/labels for the connected account. Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/folders.

tools.name: nylas_list_calendars
tools.description: List calendars for the connected account (each has a calendar_id used by the events tools). Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/calendars.

tools.name: nylas_get_calendar
tools.description: Get a single calendar by id. Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/calendars/{calendar_id}.

tools.name: nylas_list_events
tools.description: List calendar events. Requires calendar_id (sent as a query param). Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/events.

tools.name: nylas_get_event
tools.description: Get a single calendar event by id. Requires calendar_id (sent as a query param). Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/events/{event_id}.

tools.name: nylas_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts for the connected account, with optional email/phone filters. Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/contacts.

tools.name: nylas_get_contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by id. Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: nylas_list_drafts
tools.description: List draft emails for the connected account. Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/drafts.

tools.name: nylas_send_message
tools.description: SENDS a real email via the connected account. This dispatches an actual message. Nylas v3: POST /v3/grants/{grant_id}/messages/send.

tools.name: nylas_create_event
tools.description: Creates a calendar event (may send invites to participants). Requires calendar_id (sent as a query param). Nylas v3: POST /v3/grants/{grant_id}/events.

tools.name: nylas_create_draft
tools.description: Creates a draft email (does NOT send — safe/additive). Nylas v3: POST /v3/grants/{grant_id}/drafts.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nylas_list_messages, nylas_get_message, nylas_list_contacts, nylas_list_drafts · Private data: nylas_list_contacts, nylas_get_contact · Public sink: nylas_list_messages, nylas_get_message, nylas_list_contacts, nylas_send_message, nylas_create_event, nylas_create_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nylas_list_messages, nylas_get_message, nylas_list_contacts, nylas_list_drafts · Private data: nylas_list_contacts, nylas_get_contact · Public sink: nylas_list_messages, nylas_get_message, nylas_list_contacts, nylas_send_message, nylas_create_event, nylas_create_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
